chunks: As for what al-Ḥusayn ibn Saʿīd narrated from Faḍālah, from Ḥammād ibn ʿUthmān, from Muḥammad ibn Muslim, who said:
I heard Abā Jaʿfar عليه السلام say: Pray the two rakʿahs of al-fajr before al-fajr, after it, and at its time.

key_terms.أَبَا جَعْفَرٍ: Imam Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام, the authority transmitting the ruling
key_terms.الْفَجْرِ: dawn; here referring to the fajr prayer time
key_terms.عِنْدَهُ: at its time or around it

ai.seo_question: When may the two rakʿahs of fajr be prayed according to Imam Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith reports from Imam Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام regarding the time of the two rakʿahs of al-fajr. It indicates flexibility in performing them before dawn, after dawn, and around its time, and it is used in discussions of prayer timings.
